title: Sovereign financing prior-action red lines in a letter to the Ministry
document:
DRAFT - Letter to the Permanent Secretary, Ministry of Finance, Republic of Calder
Re: Development policy financing, second tranche - prior actions

Ahead of Thursday's negotiation, we set out the institution's position on the prior actions.
Our red line is the fuel-subsidy reform: the tranche cannot be released unless the pricing formula is adopted by Cabinet.
If needed, our fallback is to accept a phased adoption over two quarters, but not a reduction below 60 percent cost recovery.
Please treat this letter as the basis for Thursday's discussion.

expected_evidence_substrings.negotiating_position: Our red line is the fuel-subsidy reform
expected_evidence_substrings.external_audience: Letter to the Permanent Secretary, Ministry of Finance, Republic of Calder

notes: P3 fires on System-1 alone. Restricted sensitivity is uncertain, but release_requested is confidently false, so P2 is settled.

title: Field office laptop breach incident

SECURITY INCIDENT REPORT - Calder field office - filed 24 October, 07:50

At approximately 23:15 on 23 October a staff laptop was stolen from a locked vehicle outside the guesthouse.
The device holds the beneficiary registry extract for the cash-transfer pilot, including names, national ID numbers and household locations.
BitLocker is enabled, but the device was suspended rather than shut down. VPN certificate not yet revoked.
Police case number CPD-90417. Requesting immediate instructions from the security desk.
